task_instance: In a small sample Python project with a mypy exclusion override in pyproject.toml listing two modules (sample_app.legacy_math, sample_app.other_untouched), removed sample_app.legacy_math from the exclusion list, added precise type annotations to fix the resulting mypy errors, ran targeted mypy and pytest, ran pre-commit on the changed files, and produced the skill's required Batch Summary output.
evidence: Created sample project at pyproject.toml (mypy overrides excluding sample_app.legacy_math and sample_app.other_untouched), sample_app/legacy_math.py (untyped functions), sample_app/other_untouched.py, and tests/test_legacy_math.py. Installed mypy (pre-existing) and pre-commit (pip install pre-commit). Step 1: removed 'sample_app.legacy_math' from the [[tool.mypy.overrides]] module list in pyproject.toml, leaving other_untouched excluded. Step 2: ran `mypy sample_app/legacy_math.py --strict`, found 4 no-untyped-def errors; fixed by adding precise annotations (Iterable[float], Optional[float], float attrs/returns) instead of Any; re-ran `mypy sample_app/legacy_math.py --strict` -> 'Success: no issues found in 1 source file', and `mypy sample_app` (full project respecting remaining exclusion) -> 'Success: no issues found in 3 source files'. Step 3: ran `python3 -m pytest tests/test_legacy_math.py -v` -> 3 passed. Step 4: ran `python3 -m pre_commit run --files pyproject.toml sample_app/legacy_math.py tests/test_legacy_math.py` (with PRE_COMMIT_HOME scoped to the work dir) -> trailing-whitespace and end-of-file-fixer hooks both Passed (required a one-time git clone of pre-commit-hooks over the network, which the sandbox's proxy allowed). Step 5: re-ran mypy and pytest as final verification (same passing results) and confirmed via `git status --porcelain` that only pyproject.toml and sample_app/legacy_math.py were modified (plus .gitignore added for cache dirs) - no unrelated files touched. Wrote BATCH_SUMMARY.md following the skill's exact Required Output Template with modules removed, files changed, key typing fixes, and validation pass/fail status. All commands run from and confined to the work directory; no external service writes, no credentials used, no connector/MCP tools called.
